title: 2 Thessalonians Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 2 Thessalonians 1: thanks for a growing faith under persecution, and the revealing of the Lord Jesus from heaven.

questions.text: Which three names stand at the head of this letter?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 names Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, writing to the assembly of the Thessalonians.

questions.text: Why are they bound to always give thanks to God for the readers?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says it is because their faith grows exceedingly and the love of each one toward one another abounds.

answers.text: They have sent gifts to the apostles
They have built a house of prayer
They have kept the law without fault
Their faith grows and their love abounds

questions.text: What do the writers boast about in the assemblies of God?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says they boast about their perseverance and faith in all their persecutions and in the afflictions they endure.

questions.text: What is this an obvious sign of, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 calls it an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that they may be counted worthy of God's Kingdom.

questions.text: Whom is it a righteous thing with God to repay with affliction?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict them.

answers.text: Those who do not write to them
Those who are weak in faith

questions.text: How will the Lord Jesus be revealed from heaven?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says he is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire.

answers.text: In a cloud, with a rainbow over it
With his mighty angels in flaming fire
In silence, in the middle of the night
With a sword and a golden crown

questions.text: Whom is he punishing, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he punishes those who don't know God and those who don't obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus.

answers.text: Those who were afflicted with them
Those who boast in the assemblies
Those who don't know God or obey the Good News
Those who have already fallen asleep

questions.explanation: Verse 9 says they will pay the penalty of eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might.

questions.text: In whom is he to be glorified when he comes in that day?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says he comes to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed.

answers.text: In the kings of the earth

questions.text: What do they always pray for the readers?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says they pray that God may count them worthy of their calling and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power.

answers.text: That their persecutions may be hidden
That they may come to Macedonia
That they may be given great wealth
That God may count them worthy of their calling
